LOVE_STORY_DATA.title: Our Love Story
LOVE_STORY_DATA.mainHeading: Every love story is beautiful, but ours is our favorite.
paragraphs: Some love stories begin with a grand adventure. Ours began with something much simpler—a hello.
From our very first conversation to countless late-night talks, weekend adventures, and little moments that became unforgettable memories, our story slowly became something beautiful.
Through every laugh, every challenge, and every dream we shared, we discovered that life was better together.
And now, after all the moments that brought us here, we're ready to begin our greatest adventure yet.
